title: verify.rs: compute_digest uses if/else-if chain where sign.rs uses match — standardize to match
description: compute_digest() in verify.rs dispatches on OID with an if/else-if chain. The equivalent dispatch in sign.rs (digest_alg_oid, hash_content) uses match. The OID-dispatch pattern should be consistent across the codebase. Using match on OIDs is not directly possible (OIDs are not const-comparable in match arms without a newtype trick), but the if/else-if chain could at least be structured the same way as in cert.rs verify_signature for visual consistency. Not a bug; purely a style inconsistency.
